strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Haman!
...Judau Ashta. Sharp as ever, to show up in this situation.
And with that many, no less.
Heh, I just wanted to see you, so I came on ahead!
Haman Karn... What are you planning to do?!
Can't you tell? I will drop Fifth Luna... onto Earth.
Wh-What did you say?!
Why would you do that...?!
Time is short, Judau... Now is the only time to act.
Why, Haman?! Why does it have to be now?!
This is no time for Earth people to be fighting each other!
We're being attacked by aliens and those weirdos called the Einst
and all kinds of stuff!
Heh... I told you, time is short.
If our Zeon is to stand victorious after this war... it must be now.
I'm asking you if this is really the time for that!
I fight for the ideals of Zeon...
I cannot afford to think only of the moment, like you children.
So that's supposed to be the grown-up view?! Gimme a break!
Don't think you can stay a child forever...! Judau Ashta...!
Lady Haman, allow me to deal with them...!
I knew he'd show up...! Mashymre!
I'll repay you for all the trouble you've caused me...!
Judau Ashta!
Mashymre, don't force the attack. Just keep them off of Fifth.
Yes, ma'am. I swear it on this rose's petals...
Looks like they won't be happy until they wreck the Earth...
Can't be helped... This is your own fault!
Very well. Then stop us with that "justice" of yours!
L-Lady Haman... Forgive me...!
Ugh...!
Splendid... Splendid, Londo Bell.
Gato...
I need no pity from my enemy...! But, Lieutenant, hold your head high.
You fought true to your convictions, and you defeated me!
GATO!
Excellency Delaz... Stardust has failed...! I come to join you...!
Ngh... I, of the true Zabi bloodline... finished in a place like this...?!
You keep going on about blood, but where did it all come from?!
Earth, right?!
...The land of beginnings...
Earth, which gave birth to everyone and raised them, is our home!
The Zabi blood is one part in hundreds of billions of that, right?!
If you're gonna fight over that, keep it inside Axis!
Humanity has grown too numerous!
That one part in hundreds of billions is the truly superior race...
How can a Newtype like you not understand that?!
Who cares about Newtypes and all that?!
Aliens and enemies we can't even identify are wrecking the Earth...!
People from Planet Fleed and Planet Cronos are fighting to protect it...
So why should we Earth people be ravaging our own home?!
Judau...
That's right! What Glemy's saying... is wrong!
Right now, all of humanity has to start over!
If we don't take down people like you, who get hung up on petty things,
there's no tomorrow for the Earth Sphere!
People bound by blood just get in the way!
Bound by blood... Perhaps that is so.
...You disappoint me... New... type... You...
Heh... Heheheh... To think... I'd lose... here... Finish me...
Haman, why couldn't you put that resolve of yours to better use?!
Used for harmony and cooperation, your gifts could've saved Earth...!
Hahaha... When those who went as far as the asteroid belt come back,
it proves humanity's soul is still held by Earth's gravity... It can't fly...
No one could forget the land of their home.
An alien... siding with the Federation. Even so... the Earth is exhausted...
There are not many ways left... to save the Earth we wore out...
Because... nobody cherishes their home...?
...When did it come to this...
I was born and raised in a space colony... I wouldn't know... But...
That doesn't mean fighting here will do anything...
Yes... thanks to you meddling brats... I couldn't wipe out the fools
clinging to Earth... Ugh... It's all... because of you...
Haman...
Char... I...
HAMAN!!
I'm glad I came back... Ugh...
...and got to meet such a strong child...
Judau!! Are you okay?!
Ple!
You all right, Judau?!
Kamille!
So you've come... Londo Bell!
Heh, our battleship can warp, you know!
Warp...?! I see, Londo Bell... alien technology...
If their leader Haman Karn is here...
it seems Neo Zeon has concentrated its forces here.
Captain Bright!
Neo Zeon intends to drop Fifth Luna onto Earth!
What?! Are you sure?!
Given Fifth Luna's current orbit and speed, it will definitely hit Earth.
...So that's what it was.
That asteroid...? I won't allow it...!
Geez! Why do the Zeon people love dropping things
on the Earth so much?!
Heh... Because it works best. ...Hm? This feeling... Char, are you here?
(Why the rush, Haman...!)
Heh, the Devil Gundam, was it? It bought us unexpected time.
Hoshino, if Fifth falls, can you calculate how long until
it passes the point of no return?
Omoikane, calculate from Fifth Luna's orbital path...
...Ten minutes left.
Ten minutes?! That's all we get?!
This is no time to complain! Be glad we have any!
Damn it, either way, we've got no margin at all!
We'll find out if it's impossible by trying.
If that hits Earth, then Earth... Damn it! I won't let that happen!
Yeah! Let's stop it again!
I don't know what you're thinking... but I'll stop you!
Hmph, I can understand the idea... But...!
I wish we could've taken out more enemies before everyone got here...
Don't sweat it! Running out of time is nothing new for us!
I'd like to take it easy once in a while. Everyone, you heard the comms?!
We're taking back control of this space!
Everyone, launch!
That... mobile armor...!
Major Anavel Gato?!
Ho ho... So you're here. It's been a while, Lieutenant Uraki.
...Lady Haman, I was tracking Londo Bell's main force...
My apologies for being late.
Never mind it, Major. ...I expect good work from you and Mashymre both.
Gato! So it's you...!
We have a great cause we must see through!
I won't lose to you...! Gato!
I must repay you for that time. Our bond of fate... ends here!
Don't strain yourself too much, Nightmare of Solomon.
...Lieutenant Colonel Cima, we face Londo Bell's main force.
I'll have you deal with them properly.
Tch, that old hag's here too!
They won't make this easy, huh...!
Heheheheh, so many to choose from.
...That woman... She wants to fight, too...!
We stall Londo Bell for as long as we can... Understood?
Stall them? How tedious. If we wipe out every last one of them,
it's all the same... Here we go!
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met by turn 12
We've cut their numbers down quite a bit, but...
Who knows. I doubt it'll be that easy.
Seems that way. ...Enemy reinforcements incoming.
Oh, come on, right as you say it?!
This is bad... and we're out of time!
Where do they keep coming from?
Oh well, looks like we've got no choice.
Don't overdo it, Jet.
They just don't quit, damn it.
Hah! Like I'd go down that easy! I can keep going all day!
Ugh... This feeling...
That machine... Glemy Toto?!
Hm...? Glemy... So you've come.
Glemy! Zeon can't have a future if it tries to drop something like this!
Zeon's already finished!
Finished? ...Heheh... This is no ending... It is only the beginning!
By the hand of Glemy Toto!
(He finally shows his true colors here. ...Too late, Glemy.)
What are you talking about?!
S-Something seems weird with them...
...What?
Neo Zeon against Neo Zeon... Are they splitting apart?
I have a great cause I must fight for...!
You cannot even see justice, so why do you fight...!
A great cause... I don't get that complicated stuff! But...
right now is a time when we've gotta fight!
You fight simply because you are a soldier.
You pilot a mobile suit only because of circumstance.
...But I am different...!
That's not true! Judau thinks for himself and fights!
Hmph... A mere doll...
What's so different?! You're...!
I chose a harsh path for myself... and I have no regrets!
You have no impulse welling up from within...
Scum like you, begone from my sight!
...Impulse alone is not enough, surely.
What...?!
However this battle ends... the Zabi family's ghosts must perish.
Everything... must be done over once more...!
You're merely clinging to the words "great cause."
Don't lecture me as if you knew!
Don't you get what Quattro's saying?!
This is no time for this...!
To me, you seem like the one who's most cornered.
...Silence! All forces, commence attack!
It buys time... but if that's Glemy's move, I must go out myself.
Haman Karn... So she's finally come out herself...!
The boss finally shows up, huh? Took her sweet time.
Maybe she was hiding till now 'cause she's not confident in battle?
Doesn't seem so... The mood of everyone in Londo Bell just changed...
Amuro Ray, hero of the One Year War. Oh... and Kamille Bidan too.
And... Char. What an illustrious lineup, Londo Bell.
Haman! Your role here is finished...!
Silence! If you wish to seize control of Neo Zeon,
then try getting through this first!
Haman Karn! I get it now! You're someone who shouldn't be alive!
Such impertinence from a mere boy!!
There's no time to waste!
At all costs, wipe them out in time and stop Fifth from falling!
Do you even know what kind of time this is?!
Earth... No, not just Earth, the whole Earth Sphere is in danger!
Right, there are mystery invaders in space and on Earth, too!
That is exactly why, Judau Ashta...!
What...?!
Even now, the Federation... no, the people living on Earth
won't try to do anything about it themselves.
Suppose you manage to bring every battle to an end.
...What will remain after that?
Wh-What will...?
Only humanity's same old way of life will remain.
I cannot wait for change to come, Judau Ashta.
This war... is an opportunity.
Exactly. ...But you will not be the one to rule it, Haman!
Keep quiet, little Glemy!
Wha... Ngh!
So it's okay to drop a meteor and hurt the Federation... no, Earth?!
There's no Earthnoid or Spacenoid!
We protect the place we live, ourselves!
That's right...! Hurting the place where everyone was born...!
Yeah, there's gotta be some better way!
Pretty words won't change the world!
There's nothing pretty or ugly about killing people!
Haman! You must be able to see it, the will of those who died in vain!
As long as people live, they are alone... Humanity itself is the same.
Can all humanity become Newtypes, as you showed me?!
Before that, humanity will devour the Earth...!
Can't you trust people at all?!
Hatred only breeds more hatred... Understand that!
Forget it, Judau. She's not the type who'll listen to words...!
Is fighting our only choice...!
Time is short, Judau Ashta! For humanity, there's no more...!
Blast it! Shoot down Londo Bell and Haman's forces too!
I know we're out of time... but there's a right way to do things!
We can only go forward our own way... Let's go...!
Geez!
...Mashymre Cello... You fought well...
Mashymre...
Haman! People who believed in you are dying too!!
I know! That's exactly why I can't retreat! I won't waste their will!
...Mashymre Cello... You fought well...
Mashymre...
Haman! People who believed in you are dying too!!
I know! That's exactly why I can't retreat! I won't waste their will!
Lieutenant Colonel Cima's unit...?!
Major Gato...
...Colonel?! Why do you interfere?! You betrayed Zeon...
We should be enemies!
I told you before, Major.
The Zabi family... no, even Haman, after the Zabis' fall,
merely uses the name of Zeon...!
Don't tell me the Nightmare of Solomon never noticed that.
But it's true that Haman Karn has the Spacenoids in mind...!
In the end, it only serves the Zabi family's interests.
Just like those whose souls are bound by gravity...!
...Even so, I can never side with the Federation...!
True, under today's Federation, Spacenoids and humanity
may have no future.
But can't you see this is no time for Earth people to fight...!
Captain, what are you...?
Bright! Can you pick up what Quattro and Gato are saying?!
No... They seem to be talking by contact. We can't pick it up from here.
...You don't accept the Federation either, Colonel... Then why?!
Why won't Char Aznable himself rise up?!
Now is not yet the time...!
Get back, Colonel...! I've come too far to bend my convictions now...!
GATO!
Kou Uraki...! Lieutenant! So it's you!
You told me I didn't even understand what I was fighting for!
What about you now?!
I follow my own convictions! That is why I fight here now!
If fighting for Spacenoid independence is your conviction,
then right now there are others we have to fight!
Is ignoring that and fighting anyway your conviction?! Answer me, Gato!
Nngh... This boy...!
Heh, freedom for the Spacenoids, is it... Don't make me laugh.
What's so funny...?! Colonel... you...!
What Glemy Toto is doing...
Do you think that will become the Zeon you wish for?
Nothing changes... At this rate, nothing will ever change!
Glemy Toto...!
You said there's no tomorrow for those without ideals or beliefs!
But having ideals doesn't make it okay if they're wrong!
Colonel Packard... You're here too...?!
But... the things I believed in... to change them now!
But... the things I believed in... to change them now!
If you were wrong, then just fix it!
Haman... Even Haman... must've wanted to do that!
...For a new ideal... I failed to die once again...
Gato...
...Gato...
For conviction and a great cause... but he too was a victim of the Zabis.
...He was a young man of great promise.
Glemy... You fool...
...Human potential... for some petty self-satisfaction...
...I won't let it be crushed...!
Glemy Toto... To be beaten by a brat who can't tell a cause from emotion.
Why... Damn it...
Judau...
Don't cry, Judau. She... just chose the wrong way.
...Perhaps... there is no right way.
Heh, heheheh. Haman, all talk and nothing more...
Now, strike down Haman's remaining forces and Londo Bell!
Lady Haman... Your will, we shall surely...!
Shaff! Is it safe now?!
Yes, Princess! There are no enemy signals in this area!
All right, we'll latch onto Fifth at once!
Damaged units, return to your ships! Everyone else, to Fifth Luna now!
Hey, Hazuki! During Operation Stardust, there were pulse engines
for course correction, so we were fine. Are we okay this time?!
After all this, "no way to change its course" wouldn't be funny!
Hmph, if worst comes to worst, we just smash it.
I see, a Single-Stroke Cleave would...
The debris would cause more damage. Changing its orbit is our best bet.
Fifth should be loaded with nukes to slow its descent.
We can use them to change its orbit.
Man, there's never a dull moment.
This is no time to say that!
Do you want Fifth Luna to fall on Earth?
Is the Aestivalis power supply going to hold?
Aestivalis team, please handle the work on the outer wall.
Let's hurry. It's not Operation Stardust, but time's still short.
Judau... We still have to finish the job.
I know... Kamille. But... but still...!
As Captain Amuro said earlier... Haman Karn chose the wrong way.
The way, the way... The way to what?!
Something big is about to happen in this universe.
...But too many other things are happening as well...
Everyone's anxious. ...The Einst used me however they liked...
and yet I don't understand them at all, either.
Excellen...
Is that why the Hyakki are on the move too?
...The Demon Empire too?
And the Aura Road opened up too, Show.
...Yeah. I still haven't found an answer, but...
...This chaos itself may be the true form of what's coming.
But... I think I can see the meaning of this fight beyond it.
...The way is how we end this fight, so we can see what lies beyond.
...I suppose so... A bit heavy, though.
So Haman got so caught up in blood... and revenge on the Zabi family...
...that she couldn't see anything else...?
What are you doing?! It's not over yet!
Judau, we can only fight our own way. For now, at least.
Yeah, that's right, isn't it? Judau!
Y-Yeah... You're right, Ple...
(Haman... I'll keep fighting... as the strong child you said I was.)
